component.name: Ichnos
component.summary: View, edit and remove photo metadata, safely

description.p: Photos carry traces of where, when and with what they were taken. Ichnos shows you every one of them and removes the ones you choose, without ever touching your original files.

ul.li: See all metadata, grouped by where it is stored: EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC, maker notes
Presets: remove only location, make photos share-safe, or strip everything
Tick or untick any individual tag, and edit artist, copyright, dates and descriptions
Work on whole folders at once
Writes cleaned copies and checks each one afterwards; originals are never modified
Keeps orientation and colour profiles, so photos still look right
A command-line mode for scripts: ichnos strip --preset share-safe *.jpg
Follows the Omarchy theme when available
